_comment: The manifest a human wrote for the nightly QA agent, with the two
- filesystem Full and exec Full, because the first version of the
job shelled out to a test runner and nobody narrowed it after
- legacy-metrics.demo.internal, an egress entry for an endpoint
that was decommissioned two quarters ago.
Neither is a mistake anyone made on purpose. They are what a policy
file does when it is maintained by hand next to code that moves:
`lex-os authority gate` names the two dimensions straight away. The
stale egress entry it will not touch while the code still carries a
bare [net] — std.net.get takes its URL at run time, so no allowlist
entry can be proved unused and shedding one could break the job.
Once the network call is gone entirely (v3), the proof is available
and `lex-os authority narrow` empties the list. Refusing to narrow
what it cannot prove is the discipline, not a gap in it.

goal.description: summarise the nightly run and report it
